title: Recursive Functions
subtitle: Prove termination, trace pending work, and avoid repeated subproblems
description: Distinguish recursive definitions from iterative processes, trace call occurrences, reuse solved subproblems, and handle large recurrences without deep Python call chains.
estimateNote: Author estimate, not learner-measured: lesson 35–45 minutes; seven labs 90–130 minutes (125–175 total). Work in three sessions; optional background excluded.
